property.description: Enable automatic seeding of generic reports from external runtime directory. When true, reports are automatically loaded from {application_data_directory}/configuration/reports/generic
Automatically import reports on module startup. When true, reports are imported automatically when the module starts. When false, reports must be manually imported via REST API or scheduled task.

Comma-separated list of subdirectories to scan for reports. Each subdirectory should be under {application_data_directory}/configuration/reports/ - generic: Our 114 migrated reports (*-generic.json) - legacy: Original legacy reports (backward compatibility)
Validate report categorization fields during import. Ensures category, subcategory, reportType, reportYear, and reportScope are valid.
Skip importing reports that already exist in the database (matched by UUID). When true, existing reports are updated with new data instead of creating duplicates.
